name: kinetic-type-art
description: Seventeen art-directed kinetic typography templates with exact presets: typeface strobe (one word through nine faces), one-word-per-beat slams, word corridor tunnel, perspective photo wall, type specimen grid, justified manifesto, Didone city title, scanned-sheet glitch wordmark, hyphen bridge wordmark, CRT decrypt, particle burst, anime command screen, photocopy explainer, echo stack over a halftone portrait, glyph-tracking terminal camera, bitten word and liquid art reveal. Presets cover beat maths (frames per beat), letter-spacing, free font pairings for Didone, condensed, grotesk and mono looks, riso and paper palettes in hex, 3D camera values and seeded glitch timing, from Art of the Title, Practical Typography, Fonts In Use and motion designers on X. Use when someone wants a kinetic type intro, a manifesto or lyric-style type piece, a wordmark animation or a typographic poster in motion. NOT for subtitles (caption-styles) or broadcast lower thirds (title-design).
